entities.name: Tipping Custom
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Tipping originated in English coffeehouses (boxes labeled "To Insure Promptness"). Americans adopted it after the Civil War — restaurant owners used tips to avoid paying freed Black workers wages. Anti-tipping movements repeatedly failed. Today, US servers depend on tips for 60%+ of income.
